fact: Decreto-Lei n.º 42/2025 of 10 December 2025 amends the Conectar Cabo Verde broadband access programme and states its financing comes from the State budget, the FUSI and international partners; it does not tie the programme to a named national broadband plan.
title: Decreto-Lei n.º 42/2025, de 10 de dezembro (Programa Conectar Cabo Verde)
publisher: Conselho de Ministros, Boletim Oficial n.º 124, I Série
